name: Talk2Code
description: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation, current benchmarks primarily focus on single-turn scenarios, neglecting the complexity of multi-turn interactions and user diversity. To address this gap, we introduce Talk2Code, the first benchmark for user-stratified multi-turn dialogue code generation evaluation across algorithmic problem-solving and backend programming tasks.A distinctive feature of our benchmark is its user-stratified interaction modeling.
